model: execution gas (measured locally) x gas price (live reading or operator assumption) x token price (assumed)
caveats: Execution gas is measured locally; it is chain-state-independent and therefore applies unchanged to both networks, but it has NOT been confirmed by deploying to either network.
L2 transaction cost here EXCLUDES the L1 data-availability charge for calldata, which on rollups is frequently the dominant cost. L2 figures are therefore optimistically low.
Gas prices are either one live eth_gasPrice reading or an explicit operator assumption. Either way they are volatile, and testnet gas prices do not predict mainnet economics.
USD conversion uses operator-supplied token prices, which are assumptions, not measurements. Re-run with --eth-usd and --pol-usd to re-price.
No deployment to a public testnet has been performed, so there are no real latency or throughput figures for either network.
